## About the Author

Hi! I am Jordin Shurpin, a data science student analyzing offensive metrics in collegiate softball.

## Project Background

This project investigates the relationship between home run hitting power and team winning success across collegiate softball divisions:

- **NCAA Division I**
- **NCAA Division II**
- **NCAA Division III**
- **Junior College (JUCO / NJCAA)**

It builds upon earlier milestones:
- [Milestone 3](https://jordinshurpin.github.io/milestone-3/) (Team offensive metrics)
- [Milestone 4](https://jordinshurpin.github.io/milestone-4/) (Individual Division I hitters)
- [Milestone 5](https://jordinshurpin.github.io/milestone-/) (Collegiate softball divisions analysis)

## Data Sources

- **Individual Hitters:** NCAA Division I hitting statistics compiled via the SCORE sports data repository and NCAA official softball stats (2,175 players with 100+ PA).
- **Collegiate Divisions:** Team season statistics gathered from NCAA official statistics via `softballR` and NJCAA official softball statistics (1,286 collegiate programs).

This site was created using [Quarto](https://quarto.org/) and R in VS Code.
